title: WINDI-HIOS Actor Schema
description: Identity layer schema for actors in the WINDI-HIOS Kernel

did.description: Decentralized Identifier bound to DID Genesis. Session DIDs use pattern did:windi:session:{hash8}

did_type.description: Q2 Resolution: Persistent DIDs are permanent, ephemeral DIDs are session-scoped (max 24h)

identity_scope.description: Q3 Resolution: Session scope limits to EPHEMERAL/STANDARD mutations. CRITICAL requires persistent.

tier.description: DID tier from DID Genesis. Session DIDs default to FREE.

session_id.description: Current session identifier (required for ephemeral DIDs)

ephemeral_keypair.description: Q2/Q31: Session DID keypair for buffer signatures. Discarded at session end.

verified.description: Whether identity is verified via DID Genesis

upgrade_policy.description: Q2 Resolution: Ephemeral to persistent upgrade rules

Q2.question: How to handle agent actors without persistent DID?
Q2.answer: Agents receive ephemeral DID: did:windi:session:{hash8}. Valid max 24h. Tier=FREE. Upgrade requires HD ratification (never agent-initiated, per I9).

Q3.question: Session-scoped vs persistent actor identity?
Q3.answer: Session DID: tier=FREE, max_class=STANDARD. Persistent DID: any tier, any class. CRITICAL mutations require persistent DID. Tier and mutation class are ORTHOGONAL.

_orthogonality_note: Tier (FREE/MED/HIGH/ORACLE) controls resources/rate-limits. Mutation class (EPHEMERAL/STANDARD/CRITICAL) controls governance. They are independent. A FREE actor can create STANDARD mutations. A session DID has tier=FREE AND max_class=STANDARD (not CRITICAL).
